$comment: Copy this template to an environment-specific inventory such as e2e-fixtures.staging.json,
fill it from a real deployment, and point SCVS_E2E_FIXTURES at that file. Every entry corresponds
to an F-* row in docs/qa/e2e-test-plan.md §3. Anything left out makes the cases that need it skip,
naming the fixture ID — nothing here is guessed or defaulted.
test/fixtures/e2e/ already owns the scripts that produce these: build-purpose-contracts.sh,
deploy-testnet.sh, generate-fixtures.sh, and registry.yaml records which are currently `ready`.
This file is the bridge between that registry and the suite.

F-MAINNET-READ-ONLY.note: public mainnet target for E2E-NET-01/read_only_mainnet only; no source or recipe fields means it cannot be submitted

F-LEG-1-MAINNET.note: public cli-legacy mainnet target for E2E-SUB-01; include it only after the fixed source and recorded recipe reproduce its deployed Wasm in the verifier-composed image

F-LEG-1.note: cli-legacy, supported (cliver, rsver) pair requiring a newly composed environment

F-PRIV.note: private upload canary that rebuilds to F-LEG-1's deployed bytes

F-URI-PRIV.note: A unique HTTPS-hosted archive that rebuilds to F-LEG-1. E2E-SRC-05/uri_declared_private submits it with is_public false; its source_sha256 must not have been retained by any public fixture or prior run.

F-URI-MISMATCH.note: A unique HTTPS-hosted archive that compiles against its target but produces different Wasm bytes. E2E-SRC-02/uri_declared_public_mismatch submits it with is_public true; its source_sha256 must not have been retained before the test begins.

F-LEG-2.note: the same (cliver, rsver) pair after its composed environment is cached — proves reuse

F-LEG-3.note: compiles cleanly but produces different bytes — the expected `mismatched` fixture

F-58.note: cli-58: a complete SEP-58 recipe on chain and a trusted bldimg

F-S55-A.note: SEP-55 marker present: contractmetav0 records source_repo=github:<user>/<repo>

F-S55-B.note: legacy SEP-58 v0.4.0 source_repo (an ordinary URL) — must read false

F-S55-C.note: source_repo containing but not starting with `github:` — must read false

F-S55-D.note: coexistence: a github: marker and a complete SEP-58 recipe on the same contract

F-S55-E.note: run-scoped case-sensitive discriminator: source_repo=GitHub:<user>/<repo> must read false

F-S55-F.note: run-scoped prefix boundary: source_repo=github: begins the RA5 literal and must read true

F-NONE.note: cli-none: built with plain cargo build, no cliver in metadata — must be `unsupported`

F-XNET.note: identical bytes deployed on both networks; the mainnet twin goes in F-XNET-MAINNET

F-XNET-MAINNET.note: the same bytes as F-XNET, deployed on mainnet

F-BUILD-TIMEOUT.note: Infinite build.rs submitted to one run-scoped timeout target per case; deployment LIMIT_WALLCLOCK must stop it

F-SUB09-TIMEOUT.note: Run-scoped deployed target for E2E-SUB-09/build_timeout; deploy-testnet.sh creates it from f-leg-1-official.wasm with the run's salt.

F-SUB10-TIMEOUT.note: Run-scoped deployed target for E2E-SUB-10/build_timeout; deploy-testnet.sh creates it from f-leg-1-official.wasm with the run's salt.

F-RULE-D-TIMEOUT.note: Run-scoped deployed target for E2E-DEDUP-06/build_timeout_requeued; deploy-testnet.sh creates it from f-leg-1-official.wasm with the run's salt.

F-DARK.note: source_uri under runner control so it can be taken down; see test/fixtures/e2e/dark-source-server.mjs

F-MULTIPKG.note: multi-package workspace where omitting --manifest-path builds the wrong package; source tree in test/fixtures/sample-contracts/multi-package-workspace

images.$comment: Read `accepted` out of the deployment's own policy.json rather than hardcoding it.
